title: Nashville Barrel Co "Straight from Barrel" Tasting with Bottle
includes: 60min Nashville Barrel Co "Straight from the Barrel" Experience
Guests will get to walk away with a bottle of their very own

cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Nashville Barrel Co leads the way on Bourbon experiences. We offer this Single Barrel Experience that is the first of it's kind. In the past, you had to be a store or bar to go pick your own barrel of whiskey. We made the same experience open to everyone and without the commitment to have to buy the entire barrel. You get a bottle from the favorite!
